intuition: Breadth-first search over board squares finds the fewest dice rolls, applying at most one snake or ladder after each roll.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every possible sequence of dice rolls until the final square is reached.

optimal.approach: Run BFS from square one, map each numbered square to its boustrophedon board cell, and enqueue its destination after a snake or ladder.

edge_cases: The board is numbered in alternating row directions from the bottom.
Only one snake or ladder is followed per roll.
A square is visited at most once in the shortest-path search.
